Public real sibling chromatograms from Bioconductor sangerseqR, GPL-2.
https://bioconductor.org/packages/sangerseqR/
Source repository https://git.bioconductor.org/packages/sangerseqR
Paths: inst/extdata/{heterozygous.ab1,heterozygous.scf,homozygous.scf}
Retrieved 29 October 2026. Exact source revision/hash recorded in validation artifact.
Vignette identifies heterozygous and homozygous siblings of the same region.
The SCF and AB1 heterozygous files contain identical channels, peak coordinates
and sequence. SCF examples contain no nonzero quality estimates, so quality is
reported as absent, never fabricated. Scientific test data only, not app assets.
SCF implementation is independently written from the Staden format specification.
